local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local input=require('openmw.input')
local frame=0
local sampleFrame=nil
local held=false
local segment=0
local segmentTime=0
local wasMoving=false
local points={{util.vector3(4886.2744140625,3213.18505859375,-448),util.vector3(5059.7392578125,3198.7919921875,-448),util.vector3(5205.134765625,3225.789306640625,-458),util.vector3(5342.73828125,3235.77978515625,-452),util.vector3(5482.267578125,3254.277587890625,-462)}}
local anchor=util.vector3(4726.0966796875,3079.67236328125,-438)
local step=1
local detour=false
local returnStep=nil
local movingStep=nil
local function xyDistance(a,b) local d=a-b return math.sqrt(d.x*d.x+d.y*d.y) end
local function aim(p)
 local t=camera.getViewTransform():inverse()
 local origin=t:apply(util.vector3(0,0,0))
 local f=t:apply(util.vector3(0,0,-1))-origin
 local d=p-origin
 local yaw=math.atan2(f.y*d.x-f.x*d.y,f.x*d.x+f.y*d.y)
 local pitch=math.atan2(f.z,math.sqrt(f.x*f.x+f.y*f.y))-math.atan2(d.z,math.sqrt(d.x*d.x+d.y*d.y))
 local gain=camera.getMode()==camera.MODE.FirstPerson and 1 or 2
 local function units(a) return math.max(-8192,math.min(8192,math.floor(a*5120+.5))) end
 return units(yaw*gain),units(pitch),math.abs(yaw)<.04 and math.abs(pitch)<.04
end
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 frame=frame+1
 local down=input.isKeyPressed(input.KEY.F7)
 if down and not held then sampleFrame=frame+3 end
 if not down then sampleFrame=nil end
 held=down
 if sampleFrame and frame>=sampleFrame then print('Substructure camera settled') end
 local hp=Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current
 local mp=Actor.stats.dynamic.magicka(self).current
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self) and hp>0,'Player died during eastern approach')
 if frame==5 then print('Joined northern rat ready health='..hp) end
 local rat=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x3b52f))
 assert(rat and rat:isValid(),'Original eastern goblin missing')
 local dead=Actor.isDead(rat)
 local distance=(rat.position-self.position):length()
 if dead then print('Joined northern rat dead') end
 if not dead and distance>350 then detour=true end
 if dead and detour and returnStep==nil then
  local nearest=math.huge
  for i,p in ipairs(points) do local d=xyDistance(p,self.position) if d<nearest then nearest=d returnStep=i end end
 end
 local goal=nil
 local choice=nil
 if dead then
  if not detour then choice='done'
  else
   local p=returnStep==0 and anchor or points[returnStep]
   if returnStep>=0 and xyDistance(p,self.position)<(returnStep==0 and 80 or 25) then
    print('Eastern return waypoint '..returnStep..' reached '..tostring(self.position)) returnStep=returnStep-1
   end
   if returnStep<0 then choice='done'
   else goal=returnStep==0 and anchor or points[returnStep] choice='return' end
  end
 elseif hp<55 and mp>=19 then choice='heal' goal=rat.position+util.vector3(0,0,100)
 elseif distance<=150 then choice='attack' goal=rat.position+util.vector3(0,0,100)
 elseif distance>350 and step<=#points then
  if xyDistance(points[step],self.position)<25 then print('Eastern route waypoint '..step..' reached '..tostring(self.position)) step=step+1 end
  goal=step<=#points and points[step] or rat.position choice='route'
 else goal=rat.position choice='move' end
 if goal and (choice=='return' or choice=='route') then goal=util.vector3(goal.x,goal.y,self.position.z+100)
 elseif goal and choice=='move' then goal=goal+util.vector3(0,0,100) end
 local x,y,facing=0,0,true
 if goal then x,y,facing=aim(goal) end
 print(string.format('Eastern controlled aim x=%d y=%d',x,y))
 if facing then print('Eastern controlled facing') end
 if mp>=19 then print('Eastern magicka ready') end
 print('Eastern decision='..choice)
 if choice=='done' then print('Eastern controlled encounter complete') end
 local moving=self.controls.movement>0
 if moving then
  if not wasMoving then segmentTime=0 movingStep=returnStep or step end
  segmentTime=segmentTime+dt
  if segmentTime>=(dead and .5 or 1.5) or movingStep~=(returnStep or step)
   or (not dead and distance<=150) or choice=='done' then print('Eastern controlled movement stop') end
 end
 wasMoving=moving
 if frame%15==0 then print('Eastern Player '..tostring(self.position)..' health='..hp..' magicka='..mp..' target='..tostring(rat.position)..' dead='..tostring(dead)..' route='..step..' return='..tostring(returnStep)) end
end}}}}
